Clearlake Capital Assumes Full Control of Chelsea Football Club

Clearlake Capital has taken full control of Chelsea Football Club after purchasing the remaining stakes from Todd Boehly and Mark Walter. Boehly and Walter, who were part of the ownership consortium that acquired the club previously, have now sold their holdings to Clearlake. This transaction signifies Clearlake Capital's complete ownership of the Premier League club.
